name: hero-share-app
title: Hero Share App
description: An app-marketing hero on a warm peach radial glow: slim top nav, a small row of faces vouching for 12,000+ users, and a huge two-line slogan as the centrepiece.
use: A consumer mobile app needs a warm, type-led landing banner pushing its download.
avoid: The hero runs taller than one screen, so the store buttons and photo cards land below the fold.
a11y: Avatar images in the trust pill have no alt text, and the entrance animation ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-bleed peach-to-white radial glow behind a small nav bar, a white trust pill and an enormous two-line black headline. Four grey links sit left of a red rounded Download the App button; the pill holds three tiny round faces.
behaves: The headline words and the trust pill sharpen from a blur as the section enters view while the nav slides in. The recording ends before the two store buttons and three tilted photo cards below appear.
customise: Copy, avatar photos and the three card images are inline in the JSX; the radial glow stops and red palette are literal colour values.
weight: light: A handful of elements fading in once; the background is one CSS gradient.
demo: Headline 'Share What Matters, Inspire What's Real' and the line Trusted by 12,000+ People.
issues: The recording stops under the headline, hiding the store buttons and three photo cards.
Avatar images inside the trust pill are missing alt text.
polishWhy: Confident oversized type on a soft warm glow; missing alt text and a cropped preview trail behind.

frames.note: The recording stops below the headline; download buttons and photo cards are never shown.
